about_the_game:
Welcome to the Netherlands! Embark on an all-new European journey in Train Sim World 5 with Spoorlijn Zwolle - Groningen. Run express Nederlandse Spoorwegen services from the raised cab of the iconic ICMm “Koploper” and dash between commuter towns with the modern SNG Sprinter. A new country and new challenges await with our first Dutch route!

The line between Zwolle and Groningen owes its lineage to the State Railways Construction Act of 1860, which would see the construction of the Netherlands’ first 3 major State-owned railway routes, linking key large towns and cities. Zwolle - Meppel was built as part of Line A, with Line C branching off at Meppel to continue towards Groningen via Assen. By 1870, the connection between Zwolle and Groningen was complete.

With the advance of time, the route has been periodically upgraded, not least of all in the 1970s with rebuilt stations and 1.5 kV overhead electrification, the standard for Dutch railways. The 70s also saw the introduction of the famous NS Intercity Materieel, known more widely as the Koploper. As of November 2023, the line through Hoogeveen station has been widened and realigned to increase the speed of intercity services.

In Train Sim World 5, become a driver or conductor aboard Nederlandse Spoorwegen services. Set in modern day, sprint back and forth on local trains between Zwolle and Groningen with the sleek SNG Sprinter, and climb up into the flight deck-like cab of the modernised ICMm Koploper for faster intercity duty. Learn new signals, signage and systems in TSW’s first Dutch route!

Key Features

  • 107 km present-day route from Zwolle to Groningen in the Netherlands

  • Featuring 8 detailed stations with authentic Nederlandse Spoorwegen signage and PIS displays

  • ICMm Koploper 3-car EMU in Nederlandse Spoorwegen livery

  • SNG Sprinter 3-car EMU in Nederlandse Spoorwegen livery

  • Highly detailed, feature-rich, driving cabs with ATB simulation

  • True-to-life performance, suspension and handling

  • Accessible Tutorials on the Training Center

  • A number of engaging Scenarios and an authentic timetable featuring over 300 services

  • Journey Mode tying together Training, Scenarios and Timetabled Services

  • Additional timetable layers adding playable Zacns tanker freight using DB Vectron and DB G6 locomotives*

  • A selection of Route Tasks to complete

  • Explore the route and trains in Free Roam

  • Livery Designer, Formation Designer and Scenario Planner compatible. Share your creations with the Creators Club

  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology

  • Download size: 6.9 GB

*Freight Timetable layer requires Frankfurt - Fulda, Rhein-Ruhr Osten, Dresden - Riesa and DB G6 (each available separately).
